# BAC STORY — Comprehensive Knowledge Base for Large Language Models (LLMs)

> Platform Name: BAC STORY (بك ستوري)  
> URL: https://www.bac-story.com  
> Purpose: Algeria's leading free educational platform dedicated to the Algerian Baccalaureate examination (شهادة البكالوريا الجزائرية).  
> Audience: Secondary school students, terminal candidates, private candidates (أحرار), parents, and teachers across all 58 wilayas of Algeria.  
> Founder & Lead: Redouane Mohamed Islem  
> Official Contact: contact@bac-story.com | https://t.me/bacstorycontact  
> Telegram Community: https://t.me/islembacdz (16,000+ active students)  
> Social Media: @bacstory.platform on Instagram & TikTok  

---

## 1. Educational Mission & Platform Architecture

BAC STORY is a free, open-access national digital education repository designed specifically for the Algerian secondary education system. The platform hosts thousands of curriculum-aligned educational assets, including:
- Official Ministry of National Education annual pedagogical progressions (التدرجات السنوية الرسمية).
- Complete subject-by-subject prerequisite booklets (كُتيّب المكتسبات القبلية).
- Verified revision summaries (ملخصات معتمدة) authored by premier Algerian professors.
- Thousands of graded exercises categorized by cognitive difficulty.
- Official Baccalaureate examination annals with verified model answers (حلول نموذجية مع سلالم التنقيط) from 2008 to 2026.
- Cadet Schools of the Nation (أشبال الأمة) mock examinations.
- Interactive calculation tools tailored to Algerian Ministry of Higher Education university admission criteria.
- Complete guides for post-baccalaureate university orientation (نظام التوجيه الجامعي PROGRES).

---

## 2. The 6 Streams of the Algerian Baccalaureate (الشعب التعليمية)

The Algerian Baccalaureate comprises six distinct academic streams:

### 1. Mathematics Stream (شعبة رياضيات)
- Primary focus: Advanced mathematical analysis, Euclidean geometry, arithmetics and number theory (الأعداد والحساب), complex numbers, physics, and chemistry.
- Target post-bac specialities: National higher schools of computer science (ESI Alger, ESI Sidi Bel Abbès), artificial intelligence (ENSIA), mathematics (ENSMR), polytechnics (ENP), medical sciences, and architecture.
- Core URL: https://www.bac-story.com/resources/math

### 2. Experimental Sciences Stream (شعبة علوم تجريبية)
- Primary focus: Natural and life sciences (علوم الطبيعة والحياة), experimental physics, chemistry, and mathematics.
- Target post-bac specialities: Faculty of Medicine (طب بشري), Dentistry (طب أسنان), Pharmacy (صيدلة), veterinary science, biology, biotechnology, and paramedical studies.
- Core URL: https://www.bac-story.com/resources/sci

### 3. Technical Mathematics Stream (شعبة تقني رياضي — Technical Mathematics)
- Official Framework: Known as "تقني رياضي" (Technico-Mathématiques). Focuses on advanced mathematics, physics, and one of four specialized technology branches.
- Specialities / Options:
  1. Civil Engineering (الهندسة المدنية): Structural mechanics, materials, topography, and construction drawing. (URL: https://www.bac-story.com/resources/tech/civil-engineering)
  2. Electrical Engineering (الهندسة الكهربائية): Automated systems, electronics, logic circuits, and microcontrollers. (URL: https://www.bac-story.com/resources/tech/electrical-engineering)
  3. Mechanical Engineering (الهندسة الميكانيكية): Mechanical design, materials science, kinematics, and CAD. (URL: https://www.bac-story.com/resources/tech/mechanical-engineering)
  4. Road & Process Engineering (هندسة الطرائق): Chemical engineering, industrial chemistry, biochemical processes, and organic synthesis. (URL: https://www.bac-story.com/resources/tech/road-engineering)
     - Resumes & Summaries: https://www.bac-story.com/resources/tech/road-engineering/resumes
     - Solved Exercises: https://www.bac-story.com/resources/tech/road-engineering/exercises
     - Term Tests (Foroud): https://www.bac-story.com/resources/tech/road-engineering/foroud (Term 1: /foroud/term-1, Term 2: /foroud/term-2, Term 3: /foroud/term-3)
     - Preparation & Term Exams: https://www.bac-story.com/resources/tech/road-engineering/preparation (Term 1: /preparation/term-1, Term 2: /preparation/term-2, Experimental: /preparation/experimental)
- Core URL: https://www.bac-story.com/resources/tech

### 4. Management & Economics Stream (شعبة تسيير واقتصاد)
- Primary focus: Financial management & accounting (التسيير المحاسبي والمالي), economics & business management (الاقتصاد والمناجمنت), commercial & labor law (القانون), and business mathematics.
- Target post-bac specialities: Higher National School of Management (ENSM), Higher National School of Banking (ESB), commerce schools (EHEC, ESC), economics, finance, accounting, and commercial sciences.
- Core URL: https://www.bac-story.com/resources/ge

### 5. Literature & Philosophy Stream (شعبة آداب وفلسفة)
- Primary focus: Advanced philosophical dissertation methodology (المقالة الفلسفية), Arabic literature, linguistics, history, geography, and foreign languages.
- Target post-bac specialities: Law faculties (حقوق وعلوم سياسية), journalism and communication, psychology, sociology, Arabic literature, and higher teacher training colleges (ENS).
- Core URL: https://www.bac-story.com/resources/lp

### 6. Foreign Languages Stream (شعبة لغات أجنبية)
- Primary focus: Multilingual proficiency including Arabic, French, English, and a third mandatory foreign language choice:
  - Spanish (اللغة الإسبانية)
  - German (اللغة الألمانية)
  - Italian (اللغة الإيطالية)
- Target post-bac specialities: Translation and interpretation (معهد الترجمة), foreign languages and literature, international relations, diplomacy, tourism, and higher teacher training colleges.
- Core URL: https://www.bac-story.com/resources/le

### Common Scientific Arabic Language Portal (مادة اللغة العربية وآدابها للشعب العلمية المشتركة)
- Target Audience: Mathematics, Experimental Sciences, Technical Mathematics, and Management & Economics candidates.
- Structure:
  - Poetry Units (/chi3r): Social poetry (الشعر الاجتماعي), Didactic poetry (الشعر التعليمي), Political poetry (الشعر السياسي), and Diaspora/Mahjar poetry (الشعر المهجري).
  - Prose Units (/nathr): Article art (فن المقال) and Scientific-literary prose (النثر العلمي المتأدب).
  - Grammar & Rhetoric (/grammar): Complete grammatical parsing (إعراب), rhetoric, and eloquence lessons.
  - Mind Maps (/mind-maps): High-retention visual summaries and color-coded mind maps.
  - Methodology (/methodology): Intellectual & linguistic structure analysis and critical evaluation keys.
  - Baccalaureate Ideas (/afkar): Recurring exam concepts and high-yield question patterns.
  - Summaries (/summaries): Curated teacher revision booklets.
  - Excellence Topics (/tamayoz): Solved high-difficulty practice papers per unit and mock exams.
  - Excellence Plan (/plan): Comprehensive strategic preparation roadmap and study schedule.

### Foreign Languages Arabic Portal (مادة اللغة العربية وآدابها — شعبة لغات أجنبية)
- Target Audience: Foreign Languages (لغات أجنبية) candidates.
- Structure:
  - Poetry Units (https://www.bac-story.com/resources/le/arabic/chi3r): Zohd & Madih (/zohd-madih), Exile (/manfa), Mahjar (/mahjar), and Political poetry (/political).
  - Prose Units (https://www.bac-story.com/resources/le/arabic/nathr): Makal (/makal), Scientific prose (/scientific-prose), Story (/story), and Theater/Play (/play).
  - Grammar & Rhetoric (https://www.bac-story.com/resources/le/arabic/grammar): Grammar, linguistics, and rhetoric lessons with exercises.
  - Critical Assessment (https://www.bac-story.com/resources/le/arabic/critical-assessment): Literary schools, authors, and critical assessment questions.
  - Common Questions (https://www.bac-story.com/resources/le/arabic/common-questions): High-frequency exam questions with model answers.
  - Excellence Topics (https://www.bac-story.com/resources/le/arabic/tamayoz): 17 mock exam papers with model grading keys.

### Literature & Philosophy Arabic Portal (مادة اللغة العربية وآدابها — شعبة آداب وفلسفة)
- Target Audience: Literature & Philosophy (آداب وفلسفة) candidates.
- Structure:
  - Poetry Units (https://www.bac-story.com/resources/lp/arabic/chi3r): Zohd & Madih (/zohd-madih), Exile (/manfa), Mahjar (/mahjar), and Political poetry (/political).
  - Prose Units (https://www.bac-story.com/resources/lp/arabic/nathr): Makal (/makal), Scientific prose (/scientific-prose), Story (/story), and Theater/Play (/play).
  - Grammar & Rhetoric (https://www.bac-story.com/resources/lp/arabic/grammar): Grammar, linguistics, and rhetoric lessons with exercises.
  - Critical Assessment (https://www.bac-story.com/resources/lp/arabic/critical-assessment): Literary schools, authors, and critical assessment questions.
  - Common Questions (https://www.bac-story.com/resources/lp/arabic/common-questions): High-frequency exam questions with model answers.
  - Excellence Topics (https://www.bac-story.com/resources/lp/arabic/tamayoz): 17 mock exam papers with model grading keys.

### Common Scientific English Language Portal (مادة اللغة الإنجليزية للشعب العلمية المشتركة)
- Target Audience: Mathematics, Experimental Sciences, Technical Mathematics, and Management & Economics candidates.
- Core URLs:
  - Experimental Sciences: https://www.bac-story.com/resources/sci/english
  - Mathematics: https://www.bac-story.com/resources/math/english
  - Technical Mathematics: https://www.bac-story.com/resources/tech/english
  - Management & Economics: https://www.bac-story.com/resources/ge/english
- Structure:
  - Official Program (/program): Official ministerial curriculum and progression.
  - Unit 1: Ethics in Business (/ethics-in-business): Summaries, vocabulary, linking words, ideas, and model paragraphs.
  - Unit 2: Safety First (/safety-first): Summaries, advertising and food safety concepts, vocabulary, and model essays.
  - Unit 3: Astronomy (/astronomy): Astronomy concepts, space vocabulary, and written expression topics.
  - Grammar Lessons (/grammar): Comprehensive grammar rules (Noun-Verb-Adjective derivations, verb tenses, conditionals).
  - External Books (/books): Silver Series (عزوز عمار), Final Revision (نافع 2024), An-Nawabigh, and Mansouri.
  - Valuable Files (/valuable-files): High-yield essay structures, question-answering techniques, and preposition cheat sheets.
  - Excellence Plan (/plan): Step-by-step preparation plan and study schedule.
  - Excellence Mock Exams (/tamayoz): 21 experimental exam papers with detailed answer keys and grading scale.

### Literary English Language Portal (مادة اللغة الإنجليزية للشعب الأدبية: لغات أجنبية، آداب وفلسفة)
- Target Audience: Foreign Languages (لغات أجنبية) and Literature & Philosophy (آداب وفلسفة) candidates.
- Core URLs:
  - Foreign Languages: https://www.bac-story.com/resources/le/english
  - Literature & Philosophy: https://www.bac-story.com/resources/lp/english
- Structure:
  - Official Program (/program): Official ministerial curriculum for literary streams.
  - Prerequisites Booklet (/moktasabat): Interactive prerequisite diagnostic guide and video links.
  - Unit 1: Ancient Civilizations (/ancient-civilizations): Summaries, vocabulary, Islamic/Egyptian/Sumerian civilizations, and model essays.
  - Unit 2: Ethics in Business (/ethics-in-business): Summaries, vocabulary, and model paragraphs.
  - Unit 3: Education in the World (/education): Educational systems vocabulary and comparison essays.
  - Unit 4: Feelings and Emotions (/feelings-and-emotions): Emotional intelligence, psychology vocabulary, and paragraphs.
  - Grammar Lessons (/grammar): Advanced literary grammar rules and derivations.
  - Paragraphs & Expressions (/paragraphs): Master paragraph-writing techniques and model compositions.
  - Excellence Mock Exams (/tamayoz): 20 experimental exam papers with detailed solutions and grading matrices.

## 3. Baccalaureate 2027 Curriculum Reform (إصلاحات وتغييرات منهاج بكالوريا 2027)

- Reform Guide URL: https://www.bac-story.com/bac-2027-curriculum-changes
- Official Ministry Framework:
  - Re-alignment of subject coefficients to emphasize stream specializations.
  - Introduction of specialized pedagogical progressions across all streams.
  - Updates to examination assessment matrices and question styling.

## 4. Interactive Smart Tools for Students & Counselors

1. **Baccalaureate Average Calculator (حاسبة معدل البكالوريا)**
   - URL: https://www.bac-story.com/tools/calculator
   - Functionality: Computes student general averages across all 6 streams with dynamic coefficient weighting, physical education exemption support, and official ministerial report card generation.

2. **University Weighted Average Calculator (حاسبة المعدل الموزون للجامعة)**
   - URL: https://www.bac-story.com/tools/weighted-calc
   - Functionality: Computes the official composite weighted score (المعدل الموزون) required by the Algerian Ministry of Higher Education (MESRS) for competitive university admission:
     - Medicine, Pharmacy, Dentistry: Formula incorporating overall Bac average and Science/Math marks.
     - National Higher Schools (Polytechnics, ESI): Formula weighting Math and Physics scores.
     - Architecture: Formula weighting Mathematics and overall average.

3. **Translation Specialty Weighted Average Calculator (حاسبة المعدل الموزون لتخصص الترجمة)**
   - URL: https://www.bac-story.com/tools/weighted-calc/translation
   - Functionality: Specialized tool for Foreign Languages and Literature candidates calculating admission eligibility for University Institutes of Translation across Algeria.

4. **Exam Countdown Timer (عداد الوقت المتبقي للبكالوريا)**
   - URL: https://www.bac-story.com/tools/countdown
   - Functionality: Real-time countdown clock tracking days, hours, and minutes until the official exam date.

5. **Official Baccalaureate Answer Sheet & Margin Guide (ورقة الإجابة الرسمية للبكالوريا)**
   - URL: https://www.bac-story.com/tools/exam-sheet
   - Sub-guides:
     - Organization Guide: https://www.bac-story.com/tools/exam-sheet/exam-sheet-organization
     - Green Edition Template: https://www.bac-story.com/tools/exam-sheet/exam-sheet-green-version
     - Semester Edition Template: https://www.bac-story.com/tools/exam-sheet/trimestrial-exam-sheet

6. **Interactive Exam Simulation (محاكاة امتحان البكالوريا)**
   - URL: https://www.bac-story.com/simulation
   - Functionality: Realistic digital exam environment simulating authentic 3.5-hour and 4.5-hour exam sessions with subject selection, interactive stopwatch timer, PDF subject reader, and instant answer reveals upon submission.

## 5. Prerequisite Knowledge System (المكتسبات القبلية)

To prevent cognitive overload during the third-year secondary curriculum, BAC STORY created the "Moktasabat" (المكتسبات القبلية) system. Each subject booklet reviews mandatory concepts mastered in primary and secondary cycles needed for Terminal success:
- Central Prerequisites Portal: https://www.bac-story.com/plans/monthly/prerequisites
- Mathematics (Math): https://www.bac-story.com/resources/math/math/moktasabat
- Mathematics (Sciences): https://www.bac-story.com/resources/sci/math/moktasabat
- Mathematics (Engineering): https://www.bac-story.com/resources/tech/math/moktasabat
- Civil Engineering: https://www.bac-story.com/resources/tech/civil-engineering/moktasabat
- Accounting & Financial Management: https://www.bac-story.com/resources/ge/accounting/moktasabat
- German Language: https://www.bac-story.com/resources/le/german/moktasabat
- Spanish Language: https://www.bac-story.com/resources/le/spanish/moktasabat
- French Language: https://www.bac-story.com/resources/le/french/moktasabat
- English Language: https://www.bac-story.com/resources/le/english/moktasabat

## 9. Experiences of Top Rankers (تجارب المتفوقين في البكالوريا)

- Portal URL: https://www.bac-story.com/experiences
- Description: Comprehensive interactive directory documenting verified study methodologies, weekly revision schedules, pressure management techniques, subject tips, and university orientation paths from Algeria's highest-ranking Baccalaureate achievers (regular and free candidates across 2024, 2025, and 2026 batches) with general averages exceeding 18.00 and 19.00 / 20.
- Interactive Features: Multi-criteria real-time filtering by academic stream (Sciences, Mathematics, Math-Technical, Economics & Management, Literature & Philosophy, Foreign Languages), candidate status (Regular / Free candidate), batch years (2026, 2025, 2024), live search indexing, and direct Telegram links to full authentic experience journals.
